overview: This document outlines the requirements for a new customer portal for Ridgeline Freight Solutions. The portal aims to enhance customer experience by providing self-service capabilities for shipment tracking and invoice management, thereby reducing the operational burden on internal teams.
business_problem: The current process for handling customer inquiries regarding shipment status and invoices is manual, leading to significant operational overhead for Ridgeline Freight Solutions' internal teams and a suboptimal customer experience.

objectives.text: Establish a modern customer portal to improve customer experience and reduce manual operational overhead.
Minimize the time the operations team spends manually answering tracking and invoice queries.

personas.name: Operations Team
personas.description: Internal staff members who currently handle high volumes of manual customer inquiries.
needs: Reduce manual inquiry workload for tracking and invoices.

personas.name: Customers
personas.description: External clients who require access to shipment tracking, invoices, and online services.
needs: Utilize online services for payments and queries.

personas.name: IT Manager
personas.description: Bill, the IT Manager, who manages the TMS and network infrastructure.
needs: Provide technical details for TMS and network integration.

user_journeys.name: Track an Active Shipment
steps: Customer navigates to the shipment tracking section.

Customer views the current location and status details for the selected shipment.

steps: Customer navigates to the invoices section.

steps: Customer navigates to a specific shipment's details.

functional_requirements.statement: The portal shall allow logged-in customers to view their active shipments and their current locations.
acceptance_conditions: A logged-in customer can see a list of all their active shipments.
For each active shipment, the customer can view its current location and status.

functional_requirements.statement: The portal shall enable customers to view and download copies of their invoices.
acceptance_conditions: A logged-in customer can see a list of all their invoices.
A logged-in customer can download a PDF copy of any listed invoice.

functional_requirements.statement: The portal shall provide customers with the option to pay their invoices online.
acceptance_conditions: A logged-in customer can select an invoice and initiate an online payment process.
The customer can successfully complete an online payment for an invoice through the portal.

functional_requirements.statement: The portal shall allow customers to submit support queries regarding specific shipments directly within the portal.
acceptance_conditions: A logged-in customer can initiate a support query linked to a specific shipment.
The customer can enter and submit text details for their query.

functional_requirements.statement: The portal shall allow customers to book cargo collections online through the portal.
acceptance_conditions: A logged-in customer can access a form to book a new cargo collection.
The customer can submit the necessary details for a collection request.

functional_requirements.statement: The portal shall provide customers with monthly summaries of their shipment volumes.
acceptance_conditions: A logged-in customer can view a summary report of their shipment volumes for each month.

non_functional_requirements.statement: The portal must feature a clean, modern user interface optimized for mobile devices.
acceptance_conditions: The portal's user interface renders correctly and is fully functional on common mobile device browsers.
All interactive elements are appropriately sized and positioned for touch interaction on mobile devices.

integrations.text: The portal will integrate with the existing Transportation Management System (TMS) to retrieve real-time shipment tracking details.
The portal will integrate with the finance system to retrieve invoice documents for customer access.

dependencies.text: Detailed technical questions regarding TMS and network integration depend on the IT Manager returning from holiday.

assumptions.validation_reason: This assumption requires customer confirmation regarding expected user and shipment volumes.
assumptions.text: We assume the portal will support up to 5,000 active customers and 10,000 daily tracking requests.

assumptions.validation_reason: This assumption requires customer confirmation regarding the API capabilities of their TMS and Finance systems.
assumptions.text: We assume both the TMS and Finance systems expose modern, documented REST APIs for integration.

assumptions.validation_reason: This assumption requires customer confirmation on the preferred payment gateway.
assumptions.text: We assume Stripe will be used as the payment gateway, utilizing hosted checkout to minimize PCI compliance scope.

assumptions.validation_reason: This assumption requires customer confirmation on the target cloud platform.
assumptions.text: We assume the portal will be hosted on AWS using standard serverless or containerized services.

assumptions.validation_reason: This assumption requires customer confirmation on specific security and authentication standards.
assumptions.text: We assume standard web security practices and standard username/password authentication with MFA.

assumptions.validation_reason: This assumption requires customer confirmation on the project timeline and budget.
assumptions.text: We assume a standard 4-month implementation timeline for the initial MVP release.
